decisive_items: marked osteolysis and collapse of the T1 vertebra
response.rationale: Young patient with progressive neurologic deficit and imaging showing lytic vertebral destruction with soft tissue mass and heterogeneous enhancement favors primary bone tumor over metastatic disease (no primary source) or osteomyelitis (no infectious signs).

rejected.why: Lack of fever, infectious symptoms, or disc involvement; imaging pattern more consistent with neoplasm.
No known primary malignancy; metastatic disease less likely in a 29-year-old without prior cancer history.
